description:
The trail offers great scenic views of the Northern Rocky Mountains and the Muskwa Ketchika Access Managment Area.

Trail assurance markers were posted in 2008. The attached PDF has a detailed description of the trail.

This description was supplied by the Northern Rockies Regional Municipality.

http://www.northernrockies.ca/assets/Visitors/PDFs/TeeteringRock2.pdf
directions:
Leaving Fort Nelson, head 99 kms northwest along the Alaska Highway and turn right (north) off the road where you see a blue hiking symbol sign and the large RS&T BC Green Recreation Trail sign . This will be just down the other side of
Steamboat Mountain and before reaching the turnoff to Tetsa River Park.
title: Teetering Rock Trail
